data.title: Vintage Wash Tee — Charcoal
data.sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

$media.alt: Black t-shirt on a hanger with dramatic shadows

data.summary: Enzyme-washed for that ten-years-old feel, from day one.

children.text: Enzyme and stone washed to break the fabric in before it reaches you. Faded charcoal with subtle variation in every piece — no two are identical.
Fabric: 100% organic ringspun cotton, 200 gsm, garment-dyed and pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Unisex fit — see the size guide for measurements.
